name: homebrew-install
body: Apple silicon and Intel macOS users install via a Homebrew tap: `brew tap really-knows-ai/kalide https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` then `brew install kalide` (formula `Formula/kalide.rb`); `brew upgrade kalide` upgrades. The formula downloads the arch-matching binary for the running Mac — `kalide-darwin-arm64` on Apple silicon, `kalide-darwin-amd64` on Intel — from the public GitHub Release of really-knows-ai/kalide using plain release-download `url`s (`https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/releases/download/vX.Y.Z/kalide-darwin-<arch>`) with `sha256`, fetched anonymously by Homebrew's standard downloader. No custom download strategy and no GitHub account, token or `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN` is involved. AC: on a clean Mac of either architecture with no GitHub credentials or token env vars set, tap + install succeeds and `kalide` runs; `Formula/kalide.rb` contains no `using:`/custom strategy, no `require` of a strategy file, and no reference to `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN`; `Formula/lib/github_private_release_download_strategy.rb` does not exist.
